## Description

BSpline curves whose interior knot multiplicities equal their degree introduce true C0 joins (slope discontinuities). Downstream tools requiring at least C1 fail.

## Reproducer recipe

`B_SPLINE_CURVE_WITH_KNOTS` of degree 3 with an interior knot of multiplicity 3, producing a sharp tangent break.

## Expected kernel behavior

heal — split the curve at C0 points so each piece is at least C1; emit each piece as its own `EDGE_CURVE` with shared vertices.

**Structured outcomes** (extracted from prose; for downstream auto-grading):
- allowed: `heal`
